title: Smarter Sanity Studio — Full Capability Upgrade
description: Transform the Sanity Studio into a fully-featured, intelligent CMS with working Presentation tool, automated content management, smart desk structure, and comprehensive content health monitoring. All existing data is preserved — no re-migration needed.
background: The Sanity Studio already has Presentation tool configured (@sanity/presentation via sanity/presentation), custom document actions, preview locations, and a custom navigator. However, the Presentation tool requires login to function, the desk structure has room for improvement, content health monitoring is basic, and there are opportunities to make the studio smarter with automated content validation, better onboarding, and richer inspector panels. The goal is to make the studio a joy to use — not just a data entry form.

presentation.notes: presentationTool from sanity/presentation is configured with previewUrl, draftMode, resolve.locations, and custom navigator. Requires login at localhost:3333/presentation. Works with /api/draft-mode/enable endpoint.

deskStructure.notes: Page-first IA with Homepage/Collections/Blog/Community/Settings. heroSection removed, profile is the main singleton.

documentActions.notes: 6 custom actions: perspectiveSwitcher, viewOnSite, openInPresentation, publishAndRefresh, publishAndRevalidateModal, publishAndRevalidate.

inspectors.notes: SeoPreview and ContentHealth inspectors exist but are basic.

onboarding.notes: 5-step onboarding: Profile → About → Projects → Certs → Publish.

welcome.notes: Custom Welcome component with quick actions.

skills.notes: skillsToolPlugin removed in EPIC-2. .agents/skills/ is source of truth.

constraints: All existing published data in Sanity must NOT be lost
No re-migration of content — enhance around existing data
Each epic is committed as a separate slice
Studio must remain deployable to Sanity Hosting after each epic
Presentation tool must work with existing /api/draft-mode/enable endpoint
Preview locations must map to actual frontend routes
Custom actions must not break existing publish flow

epics.title: Presentation Tool Hardening
epics.description: Ensure the Presentation tool works flawlessly: fix login flow, test draft mode, verify preview locations, improve the custom navigator, and add missing preview locations.
deliverables: Presentation tool tested and verified working
Custom navigator updated (remove heroSection, add profile)
Presentation sidebar shows correct quick-launch items

epics.title: Desk Structure Intelligence
epics.description: Make the desk structure smarter: add document counters, visual indicators, keyboard shortcuts, search improvements, and better grouping.
deliverables: Visual indicators for singletons vs collections

epics.title: Content Health Dashboard
epics.description: Build a comprehensive content health dashboard: field completeness, cross-document health, freshness tracking, and actionable recommendations.
deliverables: Enhanced ContentHealth inspector with field completeness
Cross-document health checker (orphaned refs, missing data)

epics.title: Automated Content Validation
epics.description: Add real-time content validation: required fields, data consistency, duplicate detection, and SEO checks.
deliverables: Real-time field validation with visual feedback
SEO validation (meta titles, descriptions, image alt text)
Content length validation (too short, too long)

epics.title: Smart Document Templates
epics.description: Improve document templates with smart defaults, auto-fill, and contextual suggestions.
deliverables: Smart template defaults based on existing content

epics.title: Inspector Panels Upgrade
epics.description: Upgrade all inspector panels: SEO preview, content health, data consistency, and JSON inspector.
deliverables: Enhanced SEO preview with social card mockup
Inspector tabs for switching between views

epics.title: Onboarding & Welcome Polish
epics.description: Polish the onboarding flow and welcome page: better guidance, progress tracking, and contextual help.
deliverables: Updated onboarding steps with progress tracking
Welcome page with content completion status

epics.title: Automation & Smart Workflows
epics.description: Add automated workflows: content scheduling, publish reminders, and smart notifications.

dataPreservation.strategy: All enhancements are additive — new features are built around existing data. No schema changes required for existing documents. New fields are optional with sensible defaults.
safeApproaches: Add new inspector panels without modifying existing ones
Enhance desk structure without changing document schemas
Improve templates without altering existing documents
Add validation rules as warnings, not blockers
Keep all existing document actions working
noMigrationNeeded: All GROQ queries continue to work

successCriteria: Presentation tool works at localhost:3333/presentation after login
All preview locations map to correct frontend routes
Document counters show in desk sidebar
Content health inspector shows field completeness
Onboarding guides new users through content creation
Welcome page shows content completion status
All existing data remains intact and accessible
Studio deploys to Sanity Hosting without errors

technicalNotes.presentation: Uses sanity/presentation (built-in to sanity v4). Preview URL from NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL env var. Draft mode via /api/draft-mode/enable with secret.
technicalNotes.deskStructure: Uses StructureBuilder from sanity/structure. Document counters via S.listItem().serialize().count.
technicalNotes.inspectors: Use InspectorPlugin from sanity. Custom inspectors via documentInspectors.
technicalNotes.validation: Use validation rules in schema definitions. Custom validators via defineRule.
technicalNotes.templates: Use defineTemplate from sanity. Templates registered in sanity.config.ts schema.templates.
